proposals.name: Track Order
proposals.description: When the customer asks how to track their order.
proposals.rationale: This intent is distinct because it specifically addresses customer inquiries about tracking their orders, which is a common and specific request not currently covered by existing intents. It allows for better categorization and response to a frequent customer need.

proposals.name: Product Usage and Special Features
proposals.description: When the customer asks how to use a specific product in their daily routine or inquires about its special features.
proposals.rationale: The messages indicate a distinct pattern where customers are specifically interested in understanding how to incorporate a product into their routine and what makes it unique. This is not fully covered by existing intents, which focus on general product information or effectiveness. This intent addresses a combination of usage and special attributes, which is a common customer inquiry.
